The shared involvement of the Dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase in multiple pathways supports the idea that Cholesteryl chloride may act through a common mechanism to influence MIP. The evidence highlights the importance of these protein targets in mediating the interaction, but the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain, requiring further experimental validation.
